title: What are Reducers?
overview: Reducers are pure functions that handle actions and return a new updated state. They define how the application state changes.

title: Reducer Function Rules
overview: Reducers must follow specific rules: they should be pure functions, should not modify existing state, and should always return a state value.

example.title: Reducer Rules
example.content:
✔ No direct mutation
✔ Same input gives same output
✔ Return new state

title: Handling Actions in Reducers
overview: Reducers use the action type to decide which state update operation should be performed.

title: Combining Multiple Reducers
overview: Large applications can split state logic into multiple reducers and combine them together.

title: Reducers in Redux Toolkit
overview: Redux Toolkit simplifies reducer creation by allowing direct state updates using Immer internally.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how reducers work, their rules, action handling, combining reducers, and reducers in Redux Toolkit.
